title: Buna: The Morning Ceremony
voice_style: Speak Amharic in a calm, warm, unhurried voice, like a grandchild remembering fondly
style_block: hand-painted gouache illustration, warm earth palette of ochre, terracotta and deep green, golden soft light, subtle paper grain, gentle and nostalgic, subject centered in frame, no text, no letters, no writing
character: an Ethiopian grandmother in her sixties with silver hair and a kind lined face, wearing a white cotton habesha kemis with a colorful woven border and a white netela shawl

music.caption: gentle instrumental, warm acoustic texture, soft kebero hand drum, krar lyre, light flute, Ethiopian pentatonic feel, slow, intimate, no vocals, no strong lead melody

hand drum enters with the pounding rhythm

endcard.text: Made with AI | Images: Gemini | Voice: Gemini TTS

shots.reason: Establish place and time: a quiet highland village at dawn before the day begins.
shots.image_prompt: extreme wide view of a green Ethiopian highland village at dawn, one round thatched house in the center, a thin line of smoke rising, soft morning mist, tiny figure at the doorway
shots.narration: በማለዳ፣ የቡና ሽታ ከቤታችን በር ቀድሞ ይነሳል።
shots.subtitle_en: In the early morning, the smell of coffee rises before our door even opens.

shots.reason: Introduce the grandmother and the ritual of preparing the space: fresh grass and incense show care for guests.
shots.image_prompt: medium shot of {character} kneeling on a clay floor spreading fresh green grass, a small clay incense burner with curling smoke beside her, warm light from the doorway
shots.narration: አያቴ ለምለም ሳር ትጎዘጉዛለች፤ እጣኑም ይጨሳል።
shots.subtitle_en: Grandmother spreads fresh grass, and the incense begins to smoke.

shots.reason: Sensory close-up of roasting beans to make the viewer smell the scene; the first emotional hook.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of green coffee beans roasting in a black pan over glowing charcoal, rising smoke, a weathered hand holding the pan handle
shots.narration: ቡናው በእሳት ላይ ሲጮህ፣ ቤቱ በሽታው ይሞላል።
shots.subtitle_en: As the beans crackle over the fire, the whole house fills with the scent.

shots.reason: The pounding rhythm is the sound of childhood; this is where the music's drum enters.
shots.image_prompt: medium close-up of {character} pounding roasted coffee in a wooden mortar with a long pestle, focused and calm
shots.narration: በሙቀጫ ትወቅጠዋለች፤ ያ ድምፅ የልጅነቴ ሙዚቃ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: She pounds it in the mortar. That sound is the music of my childhood.

shots.reason: Show patience: the jebena is the heart of the ceremony. A slow shot lets the idea land.
shots.image_prompt: a black clay jebena coffee pot with a long neck sitting on glowing coals, gentle steam rising from its spout, tiny cups on a tray nearby
shots.narration: ጀበናው ቀስ ብሎ ይፈላል፤ ትዕግስት የቡና መጀመሪያ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: The jebena boils slowly. Patience is where coffee begins.

shots.reason: Widen to community: coffee is not drunk alone. Shows the family and neighbours gathering.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot inside a warm traditional Ethiopian home, family and neighbors seated on low wooden stools in a circle, small cups on a tray, soft golden light
shots.subtitle_en: The neighbours arrive. Coffee brings people together.

shots.reason: Emotional peak: the long pour is the iconic image of the ceremony; the music theme returns here.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of hands pouring dark coffee from a clay jebena in a long graceful stream into small white cups lined up on a tray
shots.narration: አቦል፣ ቶና፣ በረካ፤ ሦስት ዙር፣ ሦስት በረከት።
shots.subtitle_en: Abol, tona, baraka. Three rounds, three blessings.

shots.reason: Close the loop: the tradition passes to the next generation. The viewer should feel warmth and continuity.
shots.image_prompt: medium shot of a young Ethiopian woman with braided hair in a yellow dress pouring coffee from a jebena in her own small kitchen, warm morning light, a faint memory of an older woman behind her
shots.narration: ዛሬ እኔ ቡና አፈላለሁ፤ የአያቴ ሙቀት በእጄ ውስጥ አለ።
shots.subtitle_en: Today I brew the coffee, and my grandmother's warmth lives in my hands.
